summary: Spec fidelity of the bound tests: scenario 59 names `canon migrate --commit` under approval.relay: deny, but its test runs only brief approve and policy approve (migrate deny is unproven by any test; I ran it by hand and it refuses HUMAN_ONLY naming approval.relay). Scenario 55 names brief approve, policy approve and divergence accept for each agent role, but the test loops the four roles over brief approve only. Also migrate --commit --relayed-via with no role declared, and with relay denied, succeeds silently (exit 0, the relay option ignored) when the plan re-binds no Approved: line, so the brief's 'no role + relay option -> USAGE' and 'deny -> HUMAN_ONLY' do not hold for that migrate (observed in the real binary: plain `migrate --commit --plan-digest <d> --relayed-via ask` exits 0 with nothing relayed). Impact is low: nothing human-only is recorded then.
